statement.zh: 晚前王朝至早王朝阶段，王权、行政、神庙/祭仪与丧葬建筑等制度逐渐成形；Wilkinson 将其作为形成期制度与考古的系统综述。
statement.en: From late Predynastic into Early Dynastic times, kingship, administration, cult, and mortuary architecture take institutional form — Wilkinson synthesizes formative institutions and archaeology.

editorial.notes: Statements paraphrased from cited sections of civ-ancient-egypt.md only.
